articles.title: Crypto funds suffer second-largest outflows of 2026 while XRP and HYPE attract inflows
articles.snippet: Investors pulled $1.67 billion from digital asset investment products last week, with bitcoin funds posting their largest weekly outflow of the year, according to a recent report from CoinShares.

articles.title: Citi predicts the tokenized securities market will grow to $5.5 trillion by 2030
articles.snippet: Stablecoins alone will generate a demand for up to $1 trillion worth of onchain U.S. Treasury bills and $2.6 trillion for tokenized stocks, said Citi.

articles.title: Bitcoin extends slide as spot ETF outflows hit a record while Wall Street rips on AI
articles.snippet: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $2.97 billion across 10 trading days through Friday, the longest outflow streak on record. Oil's bounce on the stalled Iran deal added pressure even as global equities hit new highs on the Nvidia and SoftBank AI trade.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETPs post largest 2026 outflow as crypto funds bleed $1.67B
articles.snippet: Crypto ETPs see $1.67 billion in outflows as the US dominates selling, Bitcoin funds log a record 2026 exit, and altcoin participation narrows sharply across markets, according to CoinShares.

articles.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX Warns $1.75 Billion IPO Investors of Potential Future Share Dilution
articles.snippet: SpaceX's amended IPO filing signals the company may issue substantial new shares in future transactions as Elon Musk expands its ambitions.
